jobs.description: The Smart Power Fab in Dresden is ramping up and every bottleneck costs output. In this role, you will not optimize a single module, but the performance of the entire fab. Together with Production, Line Control and Planning, you will put solutions into practice. You will combine operational experience with robust analysis.
